test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Sept 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

Sameera has been in ________ since she got selected for a highly paid job at a multinational company.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"seventh heaven"** means a state of extreme happiness or bliss. (सातवें आसमान पर)

 
 
• **Example: **She was in **seventh heaven** when she found out she had won the lottery.
 
 
 
• **"seventh heaven"** is used to describe a state of great joy and contentment. (सातवें आसमान पर)
 
 
• **Example: **After receiving the award, he felt like he was in **seventh heaven**.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **seventh heaven**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **All the rage** (सभी के बीच प्रचलित): Very popular or trendy at a particular time.

 
 
• **Example:** Wearing vintage clothing is **all the rage** these days.
 
 
 
• **In the dark** (अंधेरे में): Unaware or uninformed about something.
 
 
• **Example:** She was kept** in the dark **about the surprise party planned for her.
 
 
 
• **A cold day in July** (असंभव घटना): Something that is very unlikely to happen.
 
 
• **Example:** It will be **a cold day in July** when he finally apologizes.
